subject: Wir möchten etwas zurückgeben — wie können wir helfen?

triage.summary: Family father Thomas Krüger offers the club sponsorship/donations (€500–1000/year youth sponsorship, kit sponsorship via his bike workshop, or a repair-café event) and also asks about signing up his 9-year-old daughter Lea once a girls' team exists — classified as offer because the sponsorship decision needs a human.
triage.proposed_action: Forward to board/youth director for the sponsorship decision (reply may only promise a human will follow up); register/waitlist Lea for the planned girls' team and inform Thomas about the current status and contact person.

offer_options: yearly sponsored amount €500–1000 for youth (club decides use)
full kit/jersey sponsorship via the workshop
volunteer repair-café afternoon in clubhouse, donations at club's discretion

signup_interest.name: Lea
signup_interest.request: register now or add to waiting list
signup_interest.team: girls' football team for her age class (not yet existing)

policy_reason: No policy rule for intent 'offer' — defaulting to ask.
